The proposed method validates and compares with other detection techniques in terms of average precision (AP), the variety of factors, and frames per second (FPS) using the Foggy Cityscapes dataset. The qualitative results indicate that the proposed technique improves detection accuracy in deep foggy conditions.

articleTitle: Classification of Phishing Websites using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Phishing attacks have become increasingly and it is a serious threat to security of the user information. It targets unsuspecting individuals through deceptive websites that appear to be legitimate. These attacks can compromise sensitive information and also have serious consequences. Machine learning has a potential solution to address the growing threat of phishing. By training algorithms to recognize the tell-tale signs of phishing websites, it may be possible to detect and prevent these attacks before they can cause harm. In our paper, we explored the features of detecting the phishing url with the use of ML algorithms such as SVM, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes classifier, and also ensembling algorithm such as Random Forest Classifier. We examine the features that are commonly used in these algorithms and compare their effectiveness in accurately classifying websites as either Phishing or Legitimate

articleTitle: A Quad-band T-shaped Slot Antenna for Shortrange Terahertz Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: This paper presents a terahertz (THz) on-chip antenna based on the concept of microstrip feed for quad-band wireless applications. The Planar structure is chosen for the sake of circuit integration with other active components. A $40- \mu m$ FR-4 substrate is used for the design of the proposed antenna with a partial ground plane and a modified rectangular patch with a T-shaped slot is etched to achieve the desired performance. The partial ground plane reduces the back radiations of the antenna and introduces additional reactance which is responsible for the wide bandwidth. Simulation is performed using CST MWS where the reflection coefficient, voltage standing wave ratio, gain, surface current, and radiation pattern are analyzed. The dimensions of the antenna are 250×220×40$\mu m3$ which provides quad bands with the resonance frequency of 0. 3THz, 0.7THz, l.lTHz, and 1.7 THz with a maximum gain of 2. 7dBi, 3.3dBi, 6dBi, and 4.7 dBi respectively. The proposed THz antenna resonates at quad-frequency bands which are promising for short-range wireless communication.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Nano-channel FinFET For Lower Power Application
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: In this paper the simulation of junction less tri-gate nano-channel FinFET is carried out to evaluate and study its different DC and AC/RF characteristics. The Drain Induced Barrier Lowering, $I_{0 n} / I_{\text {off}}$ ratio and Sub-threshold Slope are also studied. Low value of SS of 89.83 mV/dec and higher cutoff frequency of 1.3 THz facilitates the proposed device suitable for low power and high frequency applications.

articleTitle: A Novel Dual Band Notched UWB Antenna for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: A dual-band rejected ultra wide band (UWB) antenna with a single U-type parasitic element is designed. This proposed antenna uses a slotted element and a defective ground structure (DGS) to generate an UWB spectrum with a range of frequencies of 2.92 to 11.77 GHz (120.49%). Dual elimination bands at down link (6.8-8GHz) and up link (9.71-11.32GHz) of X-band are procured by placing U-structured parasitic on over the DGS. The suggested radiator is 24×28mm<sup>2</sup>, with a peak efficiency of 92.3% and a gain of 1.4 dBi to 5.7 dBi. Simulations validate the proposed radiator for down and uplink X-band notch UWB requirements.

articleTitle: Imperceptibility and robustness study in different transform domain for copyright protection in digital image watermarking in hybrid SVD-domain
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Copyright protection of digital images through watermarking technique is one of the viable approaches for industrial and commercial applications. Sustaining a watermark’s robustness during attack and preserving the image visual quality with watermark capacity is most challenging. In this work, we show the impact of attacks on the image imperceptibility and watermark robustness for a watermarking technique in hybrid transform domain with various wavelets. We observed that (i) the excellent multi-resolution features of wavelet coefficients help to enhance imperceptibility; (ii) the stability property of SVD ensures adequate robustness; (iii) Shuffling the keys have addressed the rising of FPP occurring in the conventional SVD based systems. The performance of the technique has been enumerated through various signal processing attacks. Performance examining has been done in terms of state-of-the-art measures like PSNR, NCC, SSIM, NSR. A subjective investigation of the experimental results validates the performance of the proposed technique in each transform domain.

articleTitle: Automated Method for Calibration Findings of Auto Slide Scanner Using Automated Digital Microscopy
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Applications in the automated microscopy require careful calibration of the microscope system. In one such scenario where automated microscope is made to work with auto slide scanner, accurate measurement of the calibration parameters becomes an essential procedure. Here, we propose an automated method for finding the calibration parameters of a microscope based auto slide scanner. Microscopic images of a grid micrometer slide are analyzed for finding calibration parameters. Apart from the automated microscope and auto slide scanner, the procedure requires a digital camera and a grid micrometer slide. This calibration finding embraces the following parameters of camera and slide scanner: (a) measuring the pixel size in micrometers, (b) measuring the camera orientation and (c) measuring the linearity and uniformity of the slide scanner. The proposed method is accurate, reproducible and scalable enough to be suitable for applications requiring in-situ calibration.

articleTitle: Implementation of Perovskite Solar Cells using GPVDM
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: In this paper we are presenting about a specific type of solar cell which has both organic and inorganic light harvesting layers made up of a halide-based material. Due to the limited sources of energies available, solar is the only abundant cheap promising source of renewable energy. Research is going on to find the highly efficient solar cell technologies. We have seen that mostly silicon has been the common semiconductor material in the solar cells which are expensive and sensitive towards the climatic changes. Perovskite solar cells solves these issues since they are cheap and easy to assemble, strong and flexible. We are going to implement the software which is used to stimulate light harvesting devices like OLED, OFET, Organic solar cells etc. So, we are also going to stimulate organic solar cell to compare their efficiencies with respect to the current-voltage characteristics.

articleTitle: Extended Source Tunnel Field-Effect Transistor with Source Pocket Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: In this manuscript, a detailed analysis is done on extended source Tunnel FET (ES-TFET) in which source and channel are sandwiched up to certain extent resulting in activation of both the point and vertical tunneling. ESTFET offers a higher switching ratio of $\sim 10^{10}$ along with SSAVG of 30mV/Dec. In this device, L-shaped Source/channel (S/C) interface is formed in such a way that both vertical and lateral electric field due to gate helps to improve the tunneling probability of charge carriers through S/C interface. Further, a pocket is placed at S/C interface under the channel which results in enhancement of the ON-state current along with other dc parameters. It is clearly found that the proposed device offers ON-state current in the order of $\sim 5$ and OFF-state in the order of $\sim{18}$.

articleTitle: Metamaterial Based FSS for Wireless Applications with a Compact Size
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: In this work, a rectangular SRR-based unit cell is proposed for 5.2GHz wireless applications. The proposed structure exhibits double negative metamaterial properties. A polymide dielectric substrate material with a dielectric constant of 3.5 and a thickness of 0.1 mm was utilized to construct and validate the proposed structure.A numerical simulation tool, CSTMW studio, which works on the FDTD method is used to simulate the structure. The unit cell works between 4.90 GHz and 5.94 GHz, yielding an overall bandwidth of 1.04 GHz with 11 of -46.32 dB and the unit cell is validated with ADS tool with equivalent circuit diagram.

articleTitle: Timeline Driven Dynamic Vehicle Speed Control System For Next Generation Intelligent Transport System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: In case of automobiles, safety is critical issue in order to reduce number of incidents in speed-restricted zones. According to recent polls, within the Accidents around school zones have grown in recent years. Due to their haste to reach to the desired location as soon as possible. As a result, limiting vehicle control speed has been a major concern. To thought about, our project seeks to provide a practical and compact solution. Also the development of an automatic vehicle speed system is simple. This must be implemented in jones like schools and hospitals to bring down the accident number. This speed control method is automated, and it is built on the Arduino based microcontroller board. The prescribed ordinance was incorporated into the transmitter unit that transmits the signals, and it was taken by the receiver which is located in the vehicle using a wireless communication technology Zigbee, and thus vehicle speed was controlled automatically by the received input massage of the receiver, with the assistance of devices like speed encoder. Accidents decreased at a faster pace when this method was installed, and some drivers complained less. The primary goal of this approach is to reduce accidents. We discovered the significant accidents i.e., 80 percentage by analysing some of the papers

articleTitle: Optimized Detection of Continuous Gravitational-Wave Signals using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Identifying gravitational waves produced by binary black hole mergers has sparked an unheard-of revolution in physics and astronomy. However, due to the low magnitudes of gravitational wave signals and the inevitability of detector noise, proper processing of gravitational wave data is in high demand. In this research, we propose a deep learning technique termed convolution neural network based on a set of time-series data from “www.kaggle.com/datasets/andradaolteanu/g2net-gravitational-wave-dataset” that contains simulated gravitational waves with noise. This work uses a convolution neural network and Fourier transformation-based gravitational wave signal recognition model (CNN). According to experimental findings, the frequency-domain signal graph describes the gravitational wave signal’s features more accurately than the time-domain signal. The signal recognition accuracy has been improved using CNN’s convolutional processing.

articleTitle: FRMHPCA: Design of an Efficient Feature Representation Model for Monitoring Health Parameters Via Correlation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Health parameter monitoring for real-time environments is a multidomain task that involves parameter sensing, pre-processing, filtering, feature extraction, variance-based selection, classification, and post-processing operations. A large number of machine-learning based models are proposed for performing these tasks, but most of these models are either highly complex, or have lower efficiency when applied to real-time clinical use cases. To overcome these issues, this text proposes design of an efficient feature representation model for monitoring health parameters via correlation analysis. The proposed model initially collects health monitoring information sets from multiple sensor sources. These sets are processed via a multidomain feature extraction unit that combines frequency analysis, entropy analysis, convolutional analysis, and detailcomponent analysis. The extracted features from collected on-field sensors are stored for training purposes. While new samples given to a correlation engine, which assists in identification of similarity indices between individual features, and their respective disease types. Based on this correlation, an auto regressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) model is activated, which assists in identification of presence ampersand severity levels of different disease types. Due to use of the multidomain features ampersand their correlation levels, the proposed model is able to evaluate types ampersand severity levels for heart diseases, blood pressure related issues, and kidney related issues. The model was tested on these diseases, and showcased an improved performance of 8.3% in terms of accuracy, 4.5% in terms of precision, and 6.4% in terms of recall levels. Thus, making it useful for a wide variety of realtime clinical use cases.

articleTitle: GV Black Inspired Hierarchical Multiclass Classification using Panoramic Radiographic Synthetic Data
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to demonstrate that using the generated synthetic dataset will produce better results than the original teeth x-rays and thus be more efficient for carrying out hierarchical multiclass classification, this will also allow dental caries classification to be automated in accordance with the GV Black Standards. Five distinct models that were trained and tested using both the new and original datasets are compared. As the first step in each of these tasks, simple object detection will be used to identify each tooth, and then hierarchical classification will be used to achieve the desired results for classifying the cavities so that appropriate treatment can be determined based on the class of caries.

articleTitle: Flight controller design and Geometric Parameter Optimization for a Tandem Wing UAV
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: This work focuses on flight controller design and aircraft geometric parameter optimization without explicitly using the aircraft mathematical model and its transfer functions. The design and testing of flight controller is performed using MATLAB and X-Plane. The tandem-wing aircraft used here was designed using Plane Maker, and the same is loaded in the X-Plane environment. A PID control algorithm implemented in MATLAB/Simulink is used to control the aircraft in the X-Plane environment. The control loop is closed by sending the aircraft state parameters from X-Plane to MATLAB. A Universal Datagram Protocol (UDP) communication is established for the exchange of data between MATLAB and X-Plane. A methodology for implementing waypoint navigation is proposed, and the same is tested in the X-Plane simulation environment. To test the performance of the designed flight controller, an autonomous flight of a tandem-wing aircraft using waypoint navigation in X-Plane software is performed. The simulation is performed with and without atmospheric disturbance, and the outcomes are used to optimize the aircraft’s geometric parameters.

articleTitle: A U-net with Gated Recurrent Unit and Efficient Channel Attention Mechanism for Real-time Speech Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Speech enhancement has many real-world applications, like cochlear implants and hearing aids. We propose a Unet with a gated recurrent unit and an efficient channel attention mechanism for single-channel speech enhancement. ECA can be used to implement a novel cross-channel interaction without reducing its dimensionality. Network performance was significantly improved by using an adaptable kernel size in module testing. Additionally, the U-Net architecture uses gated recurrent units (GRU), which yields a causal system suitable for real-world use. GRU is used for learning long-range dependencies. Speakers and noise types are different for training and testing because it is independent of both. Compared to LSTM-based models, UGRU with ECA consistently leads to better objective comprehensibility and perceptual quality.

articleTitle: A Microstrip Strip Line Based High Dynamic range Optical Front-end for LiDAR Application
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: This work presents a 180 nm CMOS based transimpedance amplifier (TIA) for time-of-flight (ToF) LiDAR. The proposed design includes a T-shaped microstrip line (MSL) network as first phase, Variable Gain Common Gate (VGCG) Transimpedance as second phase, and a post amplification as final stage. The MSL section reduce the impact of the photodiode capacitance achieving higher bandwidth performance, while the VGCG provides low input impedance and performs current to voltage conversion with high dynamic range (DR). A post amplification stage is integrated at the output of VGCG TIA in order to achieve high gain. The work demonstrates a wide band of 1250 MHz, a maximum transimpedance gain, high DR and an ultra-low noise of 91.42 dB$\Omega$, 71dB, and 3.71 pA/sqrt (Hz). The TIA along with post amplification consumes a power of 33 mW.

articleTitle: Higgs Boson Detection from Monte Carlo Simulation Tensors using Wide and Deep Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Higgs Bosons are the fundamental particles with 0 spin that couple to mass and are produced by quantum excitation of the Higgs Field. They have even parity and have no electric or colour charge. It is very unstable in nature and quickly decays into other particles. Monte Carlo simulation is a probabilistic technique to estimate different outcomes in a process that are difficult to predict because of random variables. The Monte Carlo simulation method can be used to generate a probabilistic dataset containing 211ow-level features and 7 high-level features to detect Higgs Boson. Deep learning, on the other hand, is very useful to create a decision model based on a large amount of data with fast prediction capabilities. But training a deep learning model comes with requiring large computational resources. Other related works which have been conducted on this domain take a large number (50 to several thousand) of iterations to converge to a stable loss. The presented paper aims to reduce the number of iterations and resource consumption to train the dataset by using a Wide and Deep Network based learning model. The presented model converges to an AUC of 0.89 within 12 iterations hitting an early stopping condition. This shows that the presented model is more efficient than other available models.

articleTitle: Analysis of the DC and RF performance of the Double-Gate-Source-Drain Schottky Barrier Tunnel Field Effect Transistor (D-G-S-D-STFET) for high frequency applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: In this study, the performance of a Dual gate source drain schottky barrier tunnel field effect transistor (D-G-S-D-STFET) is analysed using a high k dielectric composed of HfO<inf>2</inf> and a low k dielectric composed of SiO<inf>2</inf>, respectively. The DC and the analog /RF performances of the device are examined the in-depth DC performance analysis, like transfer characteristics ($\mathrm{I}_{\mathrm{D}}-\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{GS}}$), and the RF performances like transmission frequency $(\mathrm{f}_{\mathrm{T}})$, and transconductance generation factor (TGF) are simulated using SILVACO TCAD. It has been observed that the transmission frequency $(\mathrm{f}_{\mathrm{T}})$ is in enhanced in the proposed device in the THz range compared to the conventional structures at $(\mathrm{L}_{\mathrm{G}})$ of 50nm. Further, the proposed device has shown lower power consumption, a maximum $\mathrm{I}_{\mathrm{ON}}/\mathrm{I}_{\mathrm{OFF}}$ ratio and higher ON current are observed. Therefore, proposed device has significant potential for use in applications requiring low power and high frequency.

articleTitle: Ellipse shaped graphene metamaterial absorber for terahertz applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: In this article, we proposed a Graphene meta surface based broadband absorber is proposed with a simple and straightforward structure with three layers and the proposed structure is designed and simulated by using the FDTD based numerical simulation tool like CSTMW Studio. The proposed design contains three layers of gold, quartz crystal and a graphene elliptical patch. The permittivity of lossy quartz dielectric material is taken as 3.75 and the loss tangent of 0.0004 and gold conductivity is taken as $4.561\mathrm{e}+07$. The absorption bandwidth of the proposed absorber can be altered by changing the graphene chemical potential and relaxation time. By doing parametric analysis for the graphene material ellipse horizontal radius, the absorber’s bandwidth also gets increased as compared to previously recommended absorbers. the proposed absorber is a straightforward structure with a good absorption band.

articleTitle: Model for Transmission of Multi-carriers Using Optimized Linearly Processed FBMC System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: The drawbacks in orthogonal frequency division multiplexing is upgraded using Filter Bank MultiCarrier (FBMC), in which the spectral properties are been improved. In this paper, the FBMC system is designed using optimization technique and the bits are linearly processed together designed as OLP-FBMC. This method separates the even subcarriers and odd sub carriers codes and performs filtering operation so that the signal overlapping will be avoided. To run the overlapped signals a singular value decomposition (SVD) method is used which concentrates on the linearly transformed bits. The linearly processed data is applied to optimization techniques to improve the quality of data by removing interferences. The implemented OLP-FBMC system obeys orthogonality property which can be used in MIMO transmission systems. The implemented methodology achieves better results when compared with other systems like FBMC-QAM and OFDM schemes. The bit error is evaluated for different channels at 5Hz and 70Hz. The proposed OLP-FBMC method shows better results when compared to other schemes. The results are evaluated using matlab tool.

articleTitle: Detection of estrus through automated classification approaches using vocalization pattern in Murrah buffaloes
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: The field that deals with the studying of animal sounds to detect or classify various animal conditions in an open or a closed setup. Bioacoustics has its prospective applications in speaker identification, detection of respiratory distress, estrus phases, stress induced by ecological conditions, separation and weaning and so on. In dairy cattle, especially murrah buffalo breed, inaccurate detection of estrus is a significant constraint that affects the reproductive capacity of small as well as large cattle-herds. Detecting estrus in dairy cattle at correct time assists livestock managers and farmers to augment milk production, profitability and maintaining welfare of cattle.The studies on relationship between vocal behavior and reproductive performance is still at a very primary stage. This is due to inadequate amount of research work that has been done in order to study the association between acoustic features of animal vocal sounds and estrus owing to limited publicly available dataset. Outcomes of animal vocal sounds based studies are primarily dataset-dependent, i.e., the findings are ineffective if recording conditions are unidentified. Modern developments in deep-learning and machine-learning based approaches have led to the development of high-performance non-invasive ‘‘animal sound classification system These systems, however, are built on scarce speech-corpora which is a preferred requisite for machine learning model training, which requires hours of good-quality recordings of sound of a single speaker in a noiseless environment. Developing such a good-quality sound corpus manually requires labour and time which makes the process expensive. In the present paper, the authors have executed machine-learning models like Random Forest, Decision Tree and SVM as well as a custom-built CNN architecture on a dataset and have carried out a comparative analysis of the above-mentioned techniques.

articleTitle: Animal Species Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: In forests, in order to protect wild animals, real-time animal species identification is done via picture recognition. Many computer vision approaches were first presented in the past, however they couldn’t meet the demands since accuracy decreased as technology evolved. Nonetheless, accuracy in the categorization, identification, and segmentation of pictures was significantly improved as a consequence of the inclusion of multiple approaches. In order to achieve a high degree of accuracy, this study intends to provide an effective approach for animal species picture categorization. Convolutional neural networks have been developed specifically for the categorization of images. To achieve high accuracy, final layer features are learned and synchronised to the pre-trained model. With the dataset, a variety of architectures for deep learning are evaluated.

articleTitle: Medical Mask Detection using advanced MobileNetV2
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: According to data from the World Health Organization (WHO), personal contact and respiratory droplets are the two main ways that the COVID-19 virus is spread. One of the prophylactic strategies that can stop the spread of COVID-19 and other respiratory viral illnesses is wearing a surgical mask. Therefore, it is essential to correctly wear a mark in public settings like supermarkets and shopping centers. In this study, we suggest a Face Mask Detection system to determine whether or not someone is correctly donning a mask. Face mask identification in video streams has only been the subject of a few studies. It uses OpenCV, TensorFlow-Keras, MobileNetV2, and Deep Learning to recognize face masks in a two-phase design and achieved an excellent accuracy.

articleTitle: Artificial Magnetic Conductor based Composite substrate Antenna for Low Frequency Wireless Underground Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: In the current era of Wireless Internet of Things, developing low frequency planar antennas for underground communication is a challenging task. For underground electromagnetic wave propagation, low frequencies in the range of 300 MHz to 900 MHz are optimal. As the frequency drops, the size of the planar antenna grows, making design more difficult. This paper describes a planar antenna with shorting vias and an airAMC composite substrate that operates at 385 MHz and has a peak gain of 1.3 dB. This study lays the groundwork for the development of low frequency planar antennas with positive gain and a comparably compact construction.

articleTitle: Optimized H–Inspired Algorithm and SVM Classification For Lung Tumor Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: One of the most deadly and pervasive diseases is cancer. Among all the main cancers, lung cancer is the most prevalent and has the best rate of survival. CT scans are used to identify the matching tumor, give a thorough image of the lung tumor, and monitor the tumor’s progression. Despite the fact that CT scans are preferred to other imaging methods, visual interpretation of these scans’ pictures can be challenging and delay the detection of tumors. In order to detect lung tumors early, image processing techniques are commonly used in the medical industry. An improved and hybrid technique to lung tumor detection in CT images is presented in this research. In this study, we suggested one approach that improved the one already in use. Gabor & Global Thresholding Algorithm (G<sup>2</sup>TA) and Particle Swarm optimization make up the new algorithm (PSO). The G<sup>2</sup>TA-PSO Algorithm is the name of the suggested algorithm.

articleTitle: Social Distancing Detector Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: A visual surveillance system is a tool used for analyzing and explaining object behaviors. A visual surveillance system typically includes the detection of static and moving objects. Video tracking is also used to better understand what’s happening in a scene, making it an important part of computer vision theory. This paper describes about how detecting and tracking humans is done and check whether they are following social distance or not. This paper uses the Yolo V3 object detection model, which segregates people and then attempts to determine whether they are adhering to social distance standards based on the bounding boxes that track them. This paper also shows the number of violations, and also how differently colored boxes bound around the people depending on the distance. To monitor and manage social distancing protocols, various technologies such as computer vision, deep learning approaches, and the programming language Python are often used. The motivation of this paper is to develop a method for identifying and informing officials in charge of breaches in social distance regulations in public areas.

articleTitle: Design and Comparison of Wideband Cascode Low Noise Amplifier using GAA-JLFET and GAA-NC-JLFET for RFIC Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: This manuscript describes the design of a wideband Cascode Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) using Verilog-A models and several passive components. In this paper, look up table (LUT) based Verilog-A models for GAA-JLFET (Gate All Around Junctionless FET) and GAA-NC-JLFET (Gate All Around Negative capacitance Junctionless FET) are developed with reference to their TCAD device simulation results. The models are then integrated into the Cadence EDA tool so that the proposed devices may be utilized in circuit simulation. The noise performances of the GAA-NC-JLFET based LNA have been investigated and compared with GAA-JLFET based LNA.

articleTitle: l0 Norm Based Improved Proportionate Maximum Correntropy Criterion Algorithm for Sparse System Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: To overcome the effect of impulsive noise on physical systems an algorithm was developed in the past using an improved proportionate maximum correntropy criterion (IPMCC) based on an adaptive filter incorporating l<inf>1</inf>-norm. This approach yielded satisfactory results for the identification of timevarying sparse physical systems but its execution is limited because it tends to draw the active and dominant coefficients to zero irrespective of their magnitude. To overcome the limitation of the l<inf>1</inf>-norm based IPMCC algorithm, this paper presents a l<inf>0</inf>-norm based IPMCC approach that significantly enhances the convergence rate of the inactive coefficients which influence the sparse system. Simulation findings prove that the suggested technique delivers a rapid convergence and lower steady-state error in contrast to the PMCC and l<inf>1</inf>-norm based IPMCC algorithm.

articleTitle: Mangoes Taste Detection System Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Machines have evolved significantly in recent years due to incorporating new technology. As a result, advanced machine learning and image processing have become hot issues for scholars. This study provides a deep learning-based enhanced approach for detecting mango tastes (sweet and sour) from mango photos. A total of 3132 mango image data were used for training and validation. This system employs a modified YOLO v3 algorithm. On sour mango data, this system received 0.84 for average precision (AP), 0.75 for precision, 0.94 for recall (true positive rate), and 0.83 for F1-score (combination of precision and recall), whereas, on sweet mango data, this system received 0.97 for AP, 0.98 for precision, 0.97 for recall, and 0.98 for F1-score.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Regression Models in Solar PV Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Solar energy is increasingly becoming one of the promising sources of renewable energy for versatile purposes including residential and commercial applications. Forecasting of the power output of solar photovoltaic (PV) systems with high accuracy in the short term is of significant importance for production, delivery, and storage in the energy market. This work aims to produce reliable short-term forecasting using machine learning methods such as Linear Regression, Random Forest Regression, and Decision Tree Regression. Results show 99% percent accuracy for the proposed models. The work also detects faults and abnormalities occurring in Solar PV panels with the help of results thereby enhancing the production.

articleTitle: SBM for mobile phone price classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Feature selection has been playing a significant role in many machine learning applications because of its omnipresent nature in any problem related to ML & DL. Extensive research is recorded in selecting best features. In this paper eight classifiers including SVC, KNN, ANN, RF, Decision Tree, Naive Bayes, Linear Discriminant Analysis, Logistic Regression models are applied with different feature selection algorithms including Pearson correlation, Chi-squared, Recursive feature elimination, Lasso, Tree-based, ANOVA, Mutual information, Feature importance to predict price category of mobile phones. In the proposed work after applying appropriate feature engineering techniques first we dropped the constant features using variance threshold. After that highly correlated features are dropped using Pearson correlation in order to get best features to train the model. From the results, it is evident that ANOVA-F test is working satisfactorily for the Kaggle dataset with best features. Among all the classifiers SVC with SBM classification accuracy outperforms other classifiers. When SBM is applied to SVC the accuracy is increased from 96.7% to 97.8%.

articleTitle: Prediction of Heart Disease from the Multiple Features Available in the Database by Applying Classification Models of Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: The provision of customized treatments is one of the key uses of machine learning in the healthcare industry. It enables healthcare providers to offer personalised patient care by looking into people’s medical histories, symptoms, and test results. Doctors can create specialized treatments and administer medications that target ailments in individual people by using ML in medicine and healthcare. Healthcare companies can now get analyses based on patient electronic health information thanks to machine learning (ML). This enables physicians to decide on the appropriate course of treatment for the patient more quickly. In healthcare, machine learning can also assist clinicians in assessing whether a patient is prepared for necessary medication changes. This encourages starting a treatment plan properly. In this research paper, we have used classification models for forecasting the chances of heart disease.

articleTitle: Smart Bag for Women’s Safety
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: A staggering number of women are harassed. With the growing population, the number of women who experience insecurities is rising daily. We are working to discover a solution to this significant issue for women given the quick growth of science and technology and our massive reliance on technical features. A face-recognition image capture system, GPS, and a smart location and tracking system are all supported by the architecture. Additionally, the proposed model has a siren and an electric shock. To give women the best safety tool possible, design elements have been precisely evaluated and verified.

articleTitle: Fast cost efficient Magnitude Comparator using RMG in QCA
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Now days, the requirement of reduced size, low power and high speed nano-scale computation devices is increasing day by day. Due to limiting device density and higher power consumption, CMOS rapidly approaching to its limit. The growing demand of digital circuits designing for nano-scale computation attracts attention of several researchers. QuantumDot Cellular Automata proves itself best alternate solution for Complementary-Metal-Oxide semiconductor (CMOS) technology. This paper presents a faster and cost-efficient 1-bit magnitude comparator design using 3-input rotating majority gate in QCA designer 2.0.3 tool. The presented layout is also compared with the prior reported designs to prove its efficacy. It can be found from obtained results that proposed architecture achieved 32%, 33% improvement in cells utilized and delay respectively. In addition, reduce cell count causes less power dissipation. QCA Pro tool is utilized for leakage power estimation with thermal dissipation map.

articleTitle: Diabetes Prediction Using Nature-Inspired Optimization Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Diabetes is a common genetic disease across the world. It is a chronic disease spurred by either production of insufficient production of insulin by the pancreas or less insulin use by the body. Insulin maintains the blood sugar level of the body. Uncontrolled diabetes can cause hypertension, also known as high blood glucose. Hypertension in the long run can be a cause of heart disease. Therefore, the prediction of diabetes is a major problem in the health sector. Various machine learning methods are already in use for the prediction of diabetes. Traditional methods were first used to address diabetes forecasting, but they take a while to deploy. Therefore, future research has adopted the use of various optimization strategies to solve the issue of diabetes forecasting as well as to boost system selectivity and operating speed. These methods have all proven to be successful in solving different optimization issues and also improve the model significantly. This work proposes a Logistic Regression model by the use of nature-inspired algorithms. We proposed a methodology which uses seven different optimization algorithms instead of gradient descent for linear regression. We implemented a linear regression algorithm from scratch and then used it with different optimization algorithms which improve the overall performance.

articleTitle: DST-VII based Multiple Transform Selection Algorithms for Versatile Video Coding
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Discrete Trigonometric Sine Transforms of type 7 (DST-7) recently got popular in coding of video. There is a direct relation between DCT-2 and DST-7 transforms. The relation permits joint computation of these two transforms for certain sizes of transforms. Joint computation yields fast algorithms to be incorporated for DCT-6 and DCT-7. This paper deals problem of DST-7 & DCT-8 approximations based on DCT-2. DCT-2 contains multiplication by a band matrix that has less no. of coeff.’s which are not zero per row. The Proposed solution preserve gain in coding by using MTS algorithm and minimize required no. of multiplications.

articleTitle: Fertilizer Recommendation for Rice Crop based on NPK Nutrient deficiency using Deep Neural Networks and Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Nutrient deficiency has a noteworthy impact on agriculture which results in reduced plant quality in turn reduced crop yield. A plant can have Multiple deficiencies at the same time so there is need of suggesting an appropriate Fertilizer considering all nutrient deficiencies in it. In this paper we suggested suitable fertilizer using random forest for detected nutrient deficiency from leaf images using different Neural Networks. We trained our dataset using four different Convolution Neural Networks and selected the network with highest accuracy and then the output of this network is sent to the trained model of Random Forest which suggests the suitable fertilizer. Since Potassium(K), Phosphorous(P) and Nitrogen(N) are three key nutrients required for Rice plant we considered the image dataset having leaves with N, P, K deficiencies.

articleTitle: Activity Monitoring and Alert System for Elderly People in Smart Homes
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: The rapid ageing of the population poses difficulties for elderly people who live alone. It gets more difficult for people who live in rural areas. As a result, there is an immediate need for real-time monitoring via the internet of things (IoT). In this work, An activity monitoring and alert system are proposed, which monitors health parameters such as ECG, oxygen amount in the blood, fall detection, and the person’s activity. The individual monitors his or her heart disease using various wearables. The chest strap is used to read the ECG signal, the wrist strap is used to check the oxygen level in the blood, and the footwear is used to detect falls. To reduce false alarms, three modules are integrated. For activity monitoring, multiple sensor nodes are placed throughout the house. Any deviation from the parameters sends a message to the cloud database, alerting family members, doctors, and emergency services. The proposed system is useful for providing medication and assistance on time.

articleTitle: Bird Species Recognition using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Birdwatching or Birding is observing or watching the birds which is found to be one of the serene activities to do in daily life. But recognizing the bird species is hard for humans as it requires a bit of support from the bird book. Also, in the olden days, many ornithologists and researchers faced hardships in detecting bird species and learning about the different patterns of bird species. We have developed an Arduino-based system that performs automatic bird species recognition. This system will be helpful for ornithologists, researchers, and other enthusiasts to learn about the existence of different bird species in a given geographical region. This system is developed using Arduino Uno, PIR Motion Sensor, and an ESP-32 camera. When the motion is detected, the ESP-32 camera captures the image and uploads the image to Google Drive. The images in Google Drive can be given to the trained deep learning models to predict the name of the bird species. To develop the deep learning model, we have used a Kaggle data set that consists of 450 bird species images of which 70,626 training images, 22500 test images, and 2250 validation images.

articleTitle: Dual mode Sign Language Recognizer-An Android Based CNN and LSTM Prediction model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Communication is varied important part of our life. By communicating with each other, we can interact, share our ideas and emotions. However, mute and deaf people of our society face lots of problem while communicating with normal people. Previous researches were focusing only one-sided communication i.e., Speech to Sign Conversion using only Static dataset like for Alphabets, Digits and only for specific languages. While keeping in mind the lacunae of current system, this research is about an application-based system that will serve as an interpreter for sign language, enabling two-ways communication between hearing-impaired people and normal people while working on dynamic gestures and centralized system for everyone. This system will work on two modules. One will be sign gestures to speech and other will be speech to 3-D animated sign gestures. For this purpose, dataset is collected from deaf and mute School, Dhule Maharashtra and ISL official site of size approx. 1800 words. Sign gestures to speech conversion is implemented using CNN+LSTM deep learning algorithm while Speech to 3D sign gestures is implemented by extracting keywords from live speech and developing 3D animated gestures using extracted keywords. This system will bridge the gap between deaf, mute and normal peoples.

articleTitle: Robotic machine vision system for defective screw Identification using Fisher’s LDA Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: The research work dedicated for the object identification difficulty resolved by the techniques of principal component analysis (PCA) and linear discriminant analysis (LDA) along with robotic machine vision system. The effectiveness of the proposed model is carefully considered for a case when the pictures of an object like Screw have not initially processed but managed them into a standard form in terms of back-ground, scaling, positioning and adjustment of intensity or brightness. Similarly, when processed a huge amount of image data sets it is necessary to use PCA and LDA for optimizing the computational difficulty. Here using the LDA and PCI the effectiveness of the model is analyzed. By an introducing the robotic machine vision system the identification accuracy can be enhanced to a greater label.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Valued Logic circuits utilizing Pseudo N-type Graphene Nanoribbon FETs
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Multi-valued logic (MVL) schematics are mainly attractive for nano-scale designs because of various advantages such as large density and faster operation that are harvested utilizing future technologies. This study presents a novel MVL circuits using Graphene Nanoribbon Field Effect Transistors (GNRFETs). The Pseudo N-type GNRFETs are used in proposed circuits for the operation. This technique employs controlling the threshold voltage of P-type and N-type FETs, while ensuring the operation of MVL ternary and quaternary logic designs. Compared to the complementary circuits, the proposed Multi-valued Logic circuits shows improvement in power up to 53.3%, delay up to 36.3% and power delay product (PDP) up to 67.2%.

articleTitle: Voice Controlled Humanoid Robot 3-D Printing Industrial Application
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: At this time this rapid evaluation industrial 5.0 age each and each company necessities rapidity in manufacturing to cope up with the customer’s requirements. Each and each industrialist cannot meet the expense to revolutionize its unit from manual to semi-automatic or fully automatic, automation uneconomical in India. the essential objective of our project is to develop a flexible and low-cost humanoid that may be utilized in any industry to eliminate this problem. Our humanoid is utilized in the quantity of applications by changing the program of the controller and also the structure is intended in such how that it’s proficient to gauge suitable loads but are often able to lift intermediate loads. Our humanoid has infinite possibilities of applications after implementing computing in it. it’ll also work borders in situ of kinsmen so it’ll help such a lot to our country.

articleTitle: A State Feedback Approach based Design of a Robust Yaw Control for Submersible Autonomous Robot through Semi-Definite Programming
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: This paper describes the robust optimal control algorithm for a submersible autonomous robot (SAR) to achieve the desired yaiv. Yaw rate of SAR is controlled through the design of robust state feedback optimal control law. Semi-definite programming is considered to develop the proposed robust optimal control algorithm. A linear matrix inequality (LMI) considewred in terms of linear quadratic regulator (LQR) is used to solve the control problem. A polytopic approach based robust optimal control laiv is formulated in a steering plane for SAR. For the implementation of the proposed control algorithm, YALMIP tool is used in Matlab/Simulink environment. The proposed control algorithm ensures the robust behavior by tracking the desired yaw.

articleTitle: Wavelet Transform Analysis of Dual-Stage Spectrum Sensing on Fractal Dimension Topology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: In cognitive radio (CR) networks, spectrum sensing is crucial. Wideband spectrum sensing (WSS) techniques are used in CR to locate the temporarily vacant frequency bands, enabling dynamic spectrum access (DSA). In this paper, wavelet transform as well as collaborative spectrum detection approaches are utilized for wideband dynamic spectrum accessing CR. The Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) method, along with Sevcik’s Fractal Dimension (SFD) are combined to create a selection method that enables the centralized collaborative spectrum detector to sense the spectrum bands and send the sensed data to the fusion center, where the received, data is analyzed to determine whether the spectrum is vacant or occupied. The proposed methodology is effective when applied to simulated signals with signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) greater than 0dB, as well less than 0dB.

articleTitle: Demonstration of L-Channel Tunnel FET with Triple Metal Gate for Next Generation IC Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: An L-Channel Tunnel FET with triple-metal gate is proposed and demonstrated for the first time in this paper. The usage of low bandgap material such as germanium as source and triple-metal gate with different workfunction are observed to extremely improve the device performance by increasing ON-State current to 1.09 x 1$0^{-4}A/\mu$m and decreasing OFF-State current to 3.17x 1$0^{-14}$A/$\mu$m. The difference in the metal workfunction at different gate position also reduces the ambipolarity in the device up to 2.3 x 1$0^{-15}$A/$\mu$m owing to variation in band-to-band tunneling (BTBT) rate at channel/drain interface.

articleTitle: Design and development of a microgripper for use in pipeline inspection robot
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: A microgripper has been designed here. The 12V D.C. Servomotor and Radial Cam-Knife edge follower mechanism carry out actuation. Two jaws are being deployed, out of which one is fixed, and another is movable. The fixed Jaw has straight fingers, while the movable Jaw hinged with the base carries a pivoted knife edge follower and curved fingers.

articleTitle: IoT-Based College Bus Tracking and Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: This article proposes an Internet of Things (IoT) based college bus tracking and monitoring system that can be used to track and monitor buses in real time. The system uses sensor modules such as an MQ3 sensor, thermocouple sensor, flame sensor, and PIR sensor. The proposed system will use these sensors to monitor student temperatures, detect fire and smoke in buses, and also the number of students and the health of drivers. All these sensors are connected to an Arduino microcontroller. The data collected by the sensors is sent over wireless networks to a server for storage and analysis. The analyzed data is displayed in the ThingSpeak channel.

articleTitle: Study of SQ-Net behavior using t-SNE activation by Classification of Lung Diseases in Chest Radiographs.
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Due to population ageing, urbanisation, and the risks connected to these factors, lung diseases will increasingly be a leading cause of death and morbidity. Lung conditions are increasingly being acknowledged as a major cause of death on a global scale. Therefore, it is crucial to address risk factors, increase vaccination rates, and enhance access to oxygen in order to lower lung disease mortality globally. This is important because, according to medical professionals, respiratory experts, and epidemiologists, a lack of representative estimates of the burden of lung disease is a problem that could limit the adoption of cost-effective, evidence-based strategies in the future. This inspires us to classify lung diseases such as Covid19, pneumonia, normal, tuberculosis, and pneumothorax using the deep learning model SQ-Net on chest radiographs. In order to study and comprehend the network behaviour in lung disease classification, we also applied G-CAM and t-SNE (t-Stochastic Neighbor Embedding) activation mapping to the max-pooling, final convolutional, and softmax layers.

articleTitle: Modeling of Electrochemical Treatment for Early Detection of Tumor Cells
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: By applying a constant uninterrupted current via more than two electrodes put inside alternatively close to the tumour, tumours can be treated electrochemically (EChT). To develop a reliable dose-planning system, it is essential to understand the underlying mechanism of destruction of EChT. One method for doing this is mathematical modelling. Through modelling of the anode processes, the importance of chlorine in the underlying EChT degradation mechanism has been made clear. It has been found that the production of hydrogen ions depends significantly on tissue and chlorine activities. The amount of these processes that contribute to the tissue’s acidity near to the anode and the applied current density are highly connected. Throughout the course of the treatment, early deduction time is utilised.

articleTitle: Dilated convolutions and Time-Frequency Attention for Speech Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: A Dilated Time Frequency Attention Autoencoder (DTFAAEC) model for the real-time speech enhancement is proposed which consists of a fully convolutional neural networks with time frequency attention (TFA). TFA blocks have been followed by the layers in the decoder and encoder. TFA mechanism is designed to learn important information in time, channel and frequency in Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). At different resolutions the context aggregation is helped by the dilated convolutions. To avoid the information flow from future frames, casual convolutions are used, therefore we will make the network which is applicable for the real-time applications. For upsampling we use the sub-pixel convolutional layers in the decoder. The experimental results shows better performance than the existing techniques in terms of quality scores and objective intelligibility.

articleTitle: Pre Cardiac Failure Detection using different supervised Machine Learning Methods with CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: For aspect, a convolution Neural Network (CNN) for cardiac arrest would help establish a better output. Whilst a cardiac arrest occurs, the limited interventions available to shop-affected person’s lives are related to badly affected outcomes. Therefore, the best way to enhance affected person results and lower related healthcare prices might be to prevent cardiac arrest. This remark highlights the significance of prediction models that continuously perceive excessive-risk individuals and assist healthcare providers in providing centered care to the appropriate patient at the appropriate time for the early identification of cardiac arrest patients who may need immediate medical attention. Moreover, the significant aspect lies in the proper symmetry formation or can, say, the better scenario to compute or make a clear recognition of the image having a clear resolution of the image. Starting with a small model to determine things as simple as CNN (Convolution Neural Network). In this proposed paper, we are used in seven different supervised machine learning method for simulation of ECG data set results in different time interval with different duration and amplitude. In the CNN with a partially connected convolution layer, the image has a single neuron connected to a small layer region. The CNN (convolution Neural Network) image classification takes the input, processes it and classification is done on the dimensions organized in three dimensions width, height, and depth.

articleTitle: A Circularly Polarized Modified Pill Shaped Ultra-Wideband THz Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: A Modified Pill-shaped ultra-wideband THz antenna is designed with a $45 \mu \mathrm{m}$ thick FR-4 substrate material having a dielectric constant of 4.3. Power from the source is coupled to the patch using a thin microstrip line and a quarterwave transformer. The partial ground plane reduces the back radiations of the antenna and introduces additional reactance which is responsible for wideband response and providing circular polarization over a wide frequency range. The designed antenna offers ultrawideband impedance bandwidth (IMBW) in the frequency range from 0.24THz to 2.1 THz(159 %), axial ratio bandwidth (3-dB $A R B W$) in the frequency range of 0.66THz to 1.6 THz(83.18 %) peak gain 8.17dBi and radiation efficiency approximately 87 %. Due to its compactness and ultrawideband response, this antenna can be used for spectroscopic detection and diagnosis, imaging system, sensing, biomedical imaging, and indoor wireless communication system.

articleTitle: Encryption and Decryption using optimized Reconfigurable Reversible Gate
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: In today’s technologies the power dissipation, delays, size, and heat are the toughest challenges to overcome in IC industries. If the computing element’s size is minimized, we can speedup the process and if the power loss is reduced, the heat dissipation will also be less. The preferable solution for these difficulties is the method of reversibility and QCA. The reversible computing is ever promising technology for the upcoming quantum computing technologies. The RLGs will decrease the power loss to a large extent, ideally to zero. If it is practically developed as an IC, then the complete world of electronic devices must be replaced, this initiates the new generation of the electronic world. This paper explains an application of reconfigurable logic, Encryption of data, Decryption of the same data implemented using Verilog coding. The design is verified through Xilinx Vivado software and the optimized delay is observed. The Encryption and Decryption process(E&D) is verified by the Simulation results.

articleTitle: On the Development of a Wearable Multi-Spectral Photoplethysmographic Device for Heart Rate Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Wearables, including fitness bands and smartwatches, can monitor regular photoplethysmographic signals, an optical measurement of the arterial pulse wave strongly impacted by the heart and blood vessels. Recently, there has been an increased demand for a wearable to detect cardiovascular abnormalities using photoplethysmography. The Multi-Spectral Photoplethysmograph (MSPPG) evaluates the peripheral blood volume pulsations at varying vascular depths. The sensing technology based on Multi-Spectral Photoplethysmography is regarded as superior to the commonly available photoplethysmography technology since it reduces motion artefacts and provides detailed information at different wavelengths. The Heart Rate (HR), a strong indicator of cardiac abnormalities, is detected using the Multi-Spectral Photoplethysmography (MSPPG) by utilising the optical wearable sensor SFH7072 with an analog front end and microcontroller; which aids in the decision-making process, particularly in the case of Cardio-Vascular diseases. The investigation is carried out by detecting heart rate using MSPPG in healthy volunteers by employing Electrocardiography (ECG) as a gold standard reference. A comparison of 50 healthy volunteers’ signal recordings signifies the highest degree of correlation between heart rate measured from MSPPG and ECG. The results indicate that MSPPG yields accurate peak intervals where the heart rate can be computed in healthy participants under ideal circumstances, emphasizing that this technique may be a possible alternative to ECG and that the sensor can be further employed for cardiovascular disease diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Compact Elliptically Slotted Multiband Antenna for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: A novel elliptical shaped slotted antenna for multiband applications is proposed. The antenna has a 50 Ω microstrip line, a partial ground, and an elliptically slotted structured patch. The size of the radiator is 14×23 mm<sup>2</sup> that provides a triple band -10 dB impedance bandwidth of 3.2-3.5 GHz, 8.6-12.6 GHz, and 13.9-15.4 GHz for WiMAX, X-band satellite communications and Ku band applications, respectively. The suggested radiator is appropriate for WiMAX, X, and Ku multi band applications owing to its excellent agreement between the simulated and experimental S<inf>11</inf>, omni directional radiation patterns, and peak radiation efficiency of 93.28%.

articleTitle: Blockchain driven Evidence Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: When a cognizable violation like murder, abduction, rape, theft, etc. is committed, a victim or someone acting on their behalf must submit an electronic first information report (e-FIR) to the police station. Due to the centralized nature of the e-FIR database, it is possible for the offense’s record to be hacked, and it is also possible for fake e-FIRs to be purposefully registered. Data transparency and integrity are therefore major issues with the e-FIR database. Indian government launched nation-wide Crime and Criminal Tracking Network and Systems (CCTNS) during 2009 and it is an efficient e-governance system. This paper provides a blockchain solution to handle the complaints given on both cognizable and non-cognizable complaints. Using real-world examples from previous events, the technology and security underlying the use of blockchain will be discussed. Police will file an e-FIR, which will be validated by the authorities, and on acceptance of the FIR, it will be encrypted and stored as a hash along with the timestamp and hash of the next block. Now, how blockchain makes it secure is that it doesn’t let anybody make changes to the FIR without proof of work and a vote of consensus in which a majority of the blockchain must agree to the change. The hash will be stored in smart contracts using Ethereum. Our findings demonstrate a trade-off between the number of transactions contained in a single block on the blockchain ledger and the security level of various hashing algorithms for the offence data.

articleTitle: Caffe-MobileNetV2 based Tomato Leaf Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: One of the most popular and widely farmed crops in India is the tomato, which is the second larger producer in the world. Tomatoes are frequently utilized in commercial and residential kitchens because these are the main plant product. The tomato plants are vulnerable to plant diseases, like late blight and Septoria leaf spot. Both the quantity and quality of crops are quickly and easily impacted by these plant diseases. The goal of this research is to use deep learning (DL) to assist in the identification and detection of diseases containing 2 classes. Total data of 6980 images used in this paper related to tomato leaves by the extraction of features such as color, texture, as well as shape. The idea in the proposed paper is carried out by using deep learning and a model called Caffe-MobileNetV2 (CMNV2) is used to classify images and extract features from them. In this work, five different layers are added to the pre-trained MobileNetV2 architecture with fewer training parameters. At the same time, a Caffe model is such a convolutional structure for faster feature embedding applied to the given tomato leaf disease detection for improving the classification accuracy. Experimental outcomes proved that the suggested CMNV2 methodology has worked quite well using the deep neural network (DNN) architecture with transfer learning. Our model achieved an overall accuracy of 99.28% as compared to previous models with utilizing less parameters.

articleTitle: Emotion Based Song Suggestion System for Tamil Language
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Music has become an integral part of our daily lives. An individual’s mood can often be determined by looking at their face. The aim of this paper is to suggest a playlist by detecting the current emotional state of an individual. A subset of the FER2013 (Facial Emotional Recognition) dataset is used in this study for facial expression detection along with the dataset from music streaming platform. Different machine learning models like Decision Tree, Adaptive Boosting, Extreme Gradient Boosting, Gaussian Naive Bayes, Ensemble Learning models are used to train and test our later dataset. The MobileNet architecture was trained and tested on the former mentioned dataset to detect facial emotions. The proposed models are evaluated using the confusion matrix from which the accuracy, precision, and recall scores are extracted. Ensemble Learning achieved an accuracy of 89.6% while the MobileNet model obtained a training accuracy of 75% and validation accuracy of 62%.

articleTitle: Object Classification Using A rtificial I ntelligence Technique s i n Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Autonomous or self-driving vehicles are self- decision systems that must choose their next course of action when an object or other vehicle is spotted on the road. Smooth driving is crucial for self-driving cars to avoid causing other road users to become stranded in a traffic jam. For autonomous vehicles, understanding traffic objects is crucial. The self-driving automobile can perform the required action after identifying an object’s precise class. Self-driving cars should be extra cautious when passing big vehicles like buses or trucks if they are identified. Consequently, one of the key capabilities of self-driving automobiles is object identification. Computer vision tasks like object classification can be useful for object recognition. Deep learning is a key subfield of machine learning and crucial for a number of computer vision applications such object detection, localization, and classification. In this paper, we present a model for real-time object classification using the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) of AI approach. It includes a thorough discussion of various deep learning techniques for classifying objects in RGB pictures and LiDAR point clouds.

articleTitle: Unified Parsing Script using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Gathering noiseless data is an important phase in fields such as machine learning and target advertising and is also one of the most tedious processes. The evolution of the Internet has made it the largest source of data, in every domain. Web scraping can be defined as the process of extracting and parsing information from unstructured web pages. Advancement in web scraping has provided us with tools such as BeautifulSoup, lxml, and Selenium, which precisely extract information from webpages based on the knowledge of the HTML document to be parsed. Nevertheless, one major inconvenience associated with such primitive web scrapers is that they are site-dependent. They have to be adapted for each new website. In this paper, we propose a machine learning based approach that searches for patterns in the semantics of the webpages of a single domain, capable of acting as a site-independent web scraper. The strategy proposed involves an algorithm that utilizes the results of three independent machine learning models to extract key information from web pages belonging to a specific domain. The experimental analysis of the simulation demonstrates that the solution proposed enhances the process of web scraping by enabling a single web scraper to extract data accurately from multiple websites, thus improving productivity.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Model on Healthcare Based Chatbot and Appointment System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: This paper discusses the clinical chatbot which could examine the contamination and deliver essential insights regarding the contamination previous to counseling a specialist. To lower the healthcare charges and similarly increase openness to clinical facts the clinical chatbot is constructed. Certain chatbots pass approximately as clinical reference books, which facilitates the affected person to discover approximately their contamination and assists with running on their fitness. The person can accomplish the real gain of a chatbot simply while it is able to examine all forms of infections and deliver essential data. In later sections of the paper, a doctor appointment system software is also discussed that is integrated with the chatbot so that the specialist which is recommended by medical chatbot can be easily visited at the mutually agreed time of both specialist and patient. Such an appointment system has its own advantages like it reduces the waiting time of the patient, patients can choose the appointment time in keeping with their desire additionally to be had and booked slots are proven in powerful graphical person interface.

articleTitle: Unconditional Generation of Scalable Chinese Characters as Bézier Curve Sequences
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International conference on Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing (AISP)
abstract: Neural generative modelling of sketches has been an active research direction. SketchRNN set a milestone with their sequence-to-sequence variational autoencoder architecture being able to generate hand drawn sketches in various classes by modelling them as sequences of displacements between consecutive stroke points. The diversity and variety in the set of handwritten Chinese characters makes them a good candidate for such generative modelling enabling their unconditional generation. However, modelling them as sequences of points causes coarse looking strokes and much longer sequences, consequently requiring use of polygonal approximation algorithms to cut down on points. Instead, we propose and investigate the modelling of Chinese characters as sequences of Bézier curves using the SketchRNN architecture with a few modifications, to allow the model to directly generate smooth curves. This way the encoded representation is smaller while more of the stroke’s characteristics are retained and the generated characters are truly scalable. We also suggest the appropriate preprocessing strategy for the KanjiVG dataset to make it suitable for this purpose. Qualitative evaluation of the results suggests the model demonstrates generation of characters with mostly well-structured and ordered strokes. This was substantiated by quantitative evaluation based on the FrFréchetchet Inception Distance score.
